0.content: The Northland Bank is Snezhnaya's state bank, founded by Pantalone soon after he became a Harbinger. Before it there were no state-owned banks: the private ones served themselves, humans followed their rules and the fae their customs. He unified both into one system, and over centuries its credibility has carried the country through several crises. It stores far more than Mora (Vesna: "many other valuable assets"), including power and data backups, in vault zones of increasing security. His office is beside the final vault, which is so deep that it is reached by the bank's private train. Pantalone told the Tsaritsa it would become the beating heart of finance.

key: Exalted Master of the Heretical Path
1.content: At twenty, Feofan was one of the test subjects in Dottore's records of an acute toxicity test; the file shows no administration or reaction, which implies he talked his way out and the Doctor treated his serious wounds instead. They became lasting partners, as Pantalone says both are not tolerated by the rules of the world. He funded Dottore's research alongside Pulcinella, and received an experimental elixir that slowed, then halted, his aging; Dottore and his Segments kept his medical records for centuries. When Dottore split his soul, one half went to Nod-Krai and the other was stored in the Northland Bank.

2.comment: Pantalone: Origins and the Scarlet Proof
2.content: Feofan Sergeyevich Veksel was born over 400 years ago in a poor, remote part of Snezhnaya. As a disruptive child he was punished often, and his mother sold him to debt collectors, which he welcomed as an escape. A foster father taught him that money could multiply; his first business failed. At twenty a gang framed him and sold him to Dottore. By thirty he had joined the Harbingers. His story is told in the Scarlet Proof artifact set (7.0).

3.comment: Pantalone: Mora, the gods and fair exchange
3.content: His grievance against the gods is economic: Rex Lapis is the sole source of Mora, so the world's currency sits in a god's hand. Item texts (Moment of Cessation from the Pale Flame set, and the weapon Cashflow Supervision) describe a man who was never favored and wants Snezhnaya to be the heart that pumps money around the world, perhaps replacing Mora, and one day stopping it by choice. Uncle Tian fears the scheme could shake the world. In 6.6 he asked Dottore, "Is it really so greedy to want the world to operate by a new set of rules?"

4.comment: Pantalone: Project Stuzha and the Veche
4.content: Pantalone and Pulcinella organise Project Stuzha, an energy-austerity program that redirects Kresnik Kristall from households toward the Armory Palace's research (Project Mistilteinn). Before it began they funded the House of the Hearth heavily and made it a key member, which Arlecchino suspects is a way to weaken it through casualties. In a Veche session in 7.0, Tartaglia argued for the armed forces and pressed him on how resources were being allocated; Pantalone answered that true consistency exists only in principle and that fairness is relative, asked if Tartaglia's equation counted for broken equipment or the age of the census, and called himself the only one who brings solutions.

5.comment: Pantalone: Seals of Life and Vesna
5.content: Against Ronova's Curse of Death, the Tsaritsa collects Seals of Life, memory bubbles that can defy death. Pantalone warned that mass collection would alert the Ruler of Life, then grasped the real design (lure her out) and offered to leak the program across Snezhnaya. The seals were kept in the Northland Bank's deepest vault. When seals vanished, Avaz pointed at him as the only person with unrestricted access; the Tsaritsa judged him too proud for the crime. Vesna and the Traveler sneaked into the bank, found him waiting in his office, and fought a beast of the Ruler of Life. He turned on the vault's Pyro turrets to open a path through its shield.
